## 10. GET /books language=ru sort=title

## 11. GET /books language=en year_from=1990 year_to=2000 sort=publication_year — phase 1/2

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.language_code = $1 AND b.publication_year >= $2 AND b.publication_year <= $3) AND b.publication_year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.publication_year ASC, b.id ASC LIMIT 21
```

## 12. GET /books language=en year_from=1990 year_to=2000 sort=publication_year — phase 2/2

## 14. GET /books publisher=…


## 15. GET /books genre=fantasy

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.genres @> ARRAY[$1]::text[]) ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 21
```

## 16. GET /books genre=fantasy language=ru sort=title

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.language_code = $1 AND b.genres @> ARRAY[$2]::text[]) ORDER BY b.title ASC, b.id ASC LIMIT 21
```

## 17. GET /books author_id=<most prolific author>

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.id IN (SELECT ab.book_id FROM author_books ab WHERE ab.author_id = $1)) ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 21
```

## 18. GET /books author=<name substring>

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.id IN (SELECT ab.book_id FROM author_books ab WHERE ab.author_id IN (
  SELECT a.id FROM authors a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND norm_text(a.full_name || ' ' || coalesce(a.original_name, '')) LIKE '%' || norm_text($1) || '%' LIMIT 1000))) ORDER BY b.title ASC, b.id ASC LIMIT 21
```

## 19. GET /books isbn=…

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.id IN (SELECT bi.book_id FROM book_isbns bi WHERE bi.isbn_13 = $1)) ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 21
```

## 20. GET /books title=<fuzzy substring>

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND norm_text(b.title || ' ' || coalesce(b.original_title, '')) LIKE '%' || norm_text($1) || '%') ORDER BY b.title ASC, b.id ASC LIMIT 21
```

## 21. GET /books q=<full-text>

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
```

## 22. GET /books created_by + created_from/created_to

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at FROM books b WHERE (b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.created_by = $1 AND b.created_at >= $2 AND b.created_at < $3) ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 21
```

## 33. GET /authors/{id}/books with cursor

```sql
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.original_title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.isbn_10, b.isbn_13,
 b.language_code, b.publication_year, b.publisher, b.page_count, b.genres, b.edition, b.external_ids,
 b.created_at, b.created_by, b.updated_at, b.updated_by, b.version, b.deleted_at, ab.role, ab.ordinal FROM author_books ab JOIN books b ON b.id = ab.book_id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ab.author_id = $1 AND (ab.book_id, ab.role) > ($2, $3) ORDER BY ab.book_id, ab.role LIMIT 21
```

## 35. GET /search type=books

```sql
SELECT s.type, s.id, s.label, s.original, s.rank FROM (
SELECT 'book'::text AS type, b.id, b.title AS label, b.original_title AS original,
  (ts_rank(b.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1))
   + word_similarity(norm_text($1), norm_text(b.title || ' ' || coalesce(b.original_title, ''))))::float8 AS rank
FROM books b
WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (b.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1) OR norm_text($1) <% norm_text(b.title || ' ' || coalesce(b.original_title, '')))
) s 
ORDER BY s.rank DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT $2
```

## 36. GET /search type=authors

```sql
SELECT s.type, s.id, s.label, s.original, s.rank FROM (
SELECT 'author'::text AS type, a.id, a.full_name AS label, a.original_name AS original,
  (ts_rank(a.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1))
   + word_similarity(norm_text($1), norm_text(a.full_name || ' ' || coalesce(a.original_name, ''))))::float8 AS rank
FROM authors a
WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (a.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1) OR norm_text($1) <% norm_text(a.full_name || ' ' || coalesce(a.original_name, '')))
) s 
ORDER BY s.rank DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT $2
```

## 37. GET /search type=all

```sql
SELECT s.type, s.id, s.label, s.original, s.rank FROM (
SELECT 'book'::text AS type, b.id, b.title AS label, b.original_title AS original,
  (ts_rank(b.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1))
   + word_similarity(norm_text($1), norm_text(b.title || ' ' || coalesce(b.original_title, ''))))::float8 AS rank
FROM books b
WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (b.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1) OR norm_text($1) <% norm_text(b.title || ' ' || coalesce(b.original_title, '')))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'author'::text AS type, a.id, a.full_name AS label, a.original_name AS original,
  (ts_rank(a.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1))
   + word_similarity(norm_text($1), norm_text(a.full_name || ' ' || coalesce(a.original_name, ''))))::float8 AS rank
FROM authors a
WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (a.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple_unaccent', $1) OR norm_text($1) <% norm_text(a.full_name || ' ' || coalesce(a.original_name, '')))
) s 
ORDER BY s.rank DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT $2
```
